turns.teacher: Good morning children, sit properly. Aaj we are doing subtraction. Fifty two minus twenty seven. Do it in your copy, jaldi jaldi.
turns.label: new_sum

turns.teacher: Rabi, what is this? Thirty five? Galat hai. You cannot take two from seven like that. Wrong. Next.
turns.label: move_on_or_scold

turns.teacher: Answer is twenty five. Fifty two minus twenty seven is twenty five. Everybody say it with me. Twenty five!
turns.label: tell_answer

turns.teacher: Arjoon, I told just now na? Borrow from tens, then tens becomes four. Borrow from tens, then tens becomes four! Listen properly, ka ho, where is your mind?
turns.label: repeat_same_way

turns.teacher: Mina, stop counting on fingers, it takes too much time. Sit down. We will do the next one.
turns.label: move_on_or_scold

turns.teacher: Now do this one. Sixty three minus twenty eight. Five minutes only.
turns.label: new_sum

turns.teacher: Answer is thirty five. Who got thirty five? Hands up. Everyone understood na? Thumbs up, sab log.
turns.label: check_whole_class
